title: Water Damage Mitigation Compliance Bulletin: Extra Vacuuming Passes for Regulated Dust
content:
**Compliance bulletin — final HEPA vacuuming on Water Damage Mitigation jobs**

Regulated dust takes extra passes: the regulated pass factor on the final HEPA vacuuming line is 2 when the building was built before the RRP year-built cutoff of the job's tier and the job carries a lead-safe setup line, 1.5 when the building was built before the asbestos sampling year cutoff and the job carries an asbestos sampling line but no lead-safe setup line, and in any other case no regulated pass factor applies. The pass factor multiplies the vacuumed square feet.

On every Water Damage Mitigation tier the RRP year-built cutoff is 1978 and the asbestos sampling year cutoff is 1981. The year built is the one on the job record; the lead-safe setup and asbestos sampling lines are the job's own charge lines.

## Truth table (hypothetical buildings)
| Year built | Lead-safe setup line | Asbestos sampling line | Regulated pass factor |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1960 | yes | yes or no | 2 |
| 1960 | no | yes | 1.5 |
| 1980 | no | yes | 1.5 |
| 1980 | yes | yes | none |
| 1981 | no | yes | none |
| any | no | no | none |

## Illustration (hypothetical)
Vacuumed areas totalling 450 square feet count as 900 square feet under a pass factor of 2, and as 675 square feet under a pass factor of 1.5.
